text:
Type: double-head white floor lamp
Use: reading and ambient light beside a sofa or armchair; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, retro, modern
Materials: white lacquered metal shades, silver-grey metal pole and round base, inline switch
Colors: white, light silver grey
Shape: two adjustable bell shades on short arms near the top of a slim pole, pointing in different directions, flat round base, tall, light and open
Feel: friendly, practical, bright, airy
Goes with: light wood, white walls, grey textiles, pops of color; Scandinavian or retro living rooms and studies

product.name: SVIRVEL
product.description: You can easily aim the light where you need it because the lamp head is adjustable. For instance, you can direct the light on the book you are reading, use it as an uplighter or aim it to focus on a specific area in the room.
